prediction_check: 0.5141463414634146 were listed within 30 days of publication and 0.2673170731707317 had Metasploit or Nuclei code before the listing.
method: Days to listing run from the publication day to the KEV dateAdded. The NVD status at the listing is the nvd_status fact current at the listing moment (the as-of join over silver.cve_fact); a CVE counts as analyzed at listing when that status was Analyzed or Modified. Exploit code is the first commit of a Metasploit module or a Nuclei template naming the CVE, before the listing moment. Intervals are a cluster bootstrap by filer, 2,000 resamples, 95 percent.
sql:
-- Q5: KEV listed CVEs published since 2021, days from publication to listing, the NVD status
-- as of the moment of listing, and exploit code seen before the listing.
select
    date_trunc('year', published) as published_year,
    count(*) as cves,
    median(days_to_listing) as median_days_to_listing,
    avg(cast(days_to_listing <= 30 as integer)) as listed_within_30_days,
    avg(cast(not nvd_analyzed_at_listing as integer)) as no_nvd_analysis_at_listing,
    avg(cast(exploit_before_listing as integer)) as exploit_code_before_listing
from gold.mart_kev_timing
group by 1
order by 1
